// diagnostic

E0914

Unknown interpolation selector after `:` (D-DISPLAYDBG2/D-FMT-INTERP1/D-FMT-INTERP3/D-FMT-PRETTY1/D-QUANTITY-PRINT1)

What

Unknown interpolation selector after `:` (D-DISPLAYDBG2/D-FMT-INTERP1/D-FMT-INTERP3/D-FMT-PRETTY1/D-QUANTITY-PRINT1)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Use `:Debug`, `:Pretty`, `:Fixed(n)`, `:Hex(n)`, `:Pad(n[, "fill"])`, `:PadLeft(n[, "fill"])`, `:Sci(n)`, `:Percent(n)`, `:Bin`, `:Oct`, `:Unit(name)`, or `:Unit(bare)`; bare interpolation is also valid.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0914: tests/ui/debug_unknown_selector.stderr.

Error [E0914]: unknown interpolation selector `:Repr`
  --> tests/ui/debug_unknown_selector.jet:3:15
    |
  3 |     print("{x:Repr}")
    |               ^^^^
 Why: string interpolation supports a closed selector set — use `:Debug`, `:Pretty`, `:Fixed(n)`, `:Hex(n)`, or `:Unit(name|bare)`
 Fix: write `{value:Debug}`, `{value:Pretty}`, `{value:Fixed(2)}`, `{value:Hex(2)}`, `{value:Unit(name)}` or `{value:Unit(bare)}`, or `{value}`
